description: Help a buyer start a chosen service: give the information to prepare, the work location, next steps and a free quote form. Use this for sample buying, inspection requirements, report deadlines or seller-channel handoff. The buyer reviews and sends the request on the website.

channel.description: Seller platform for the plan, not proof of a supported or authorized native integration.

inspectionTask.description: Choose report_before_release for inspection findings before final supplier payment, factory release or warehouse dispatch. Choose count_by_color when every unit must be counted against the expected quantity for each color or SKU. Choose measure_supplier_sample when the supplier already has the sample and the buyer wants measurements, weights or photos from the China warehouse.

quoteLanguage.description: Language of the editable quote form when the buyer wants English, German, Spanish, Japanese or Simplified Chinese. Omit to use the website language preference.

service.description: The first service the customer wants to plan; more services can be added later.

sourcingTask.description: For sourcing, choose buy_and_measure_one_sample when the buyer wants one item purchased, measured and weighed with and without its retail packaging.
